queries.sql: SELECT o.id, o.kode_pesanan, o.nama_pemesan, o.no_whatsapp, o.tanggal_acara, o.waktu_acara, o.lokasi_acara, o.nama_kecamatan, o.nama_kelurahan, o.total, o.status_pesanan, o.status_pembayaran, o.status_dekorasi, COALESCE(NULLIF(o.package_name, ''), p.nama_paket, 'Paket dekorasi') AS display_package_name FROM `orders` `o` LEFT JOIN `packages` `p` ON `p`.`id` = `o`.`package_id` WHERE `o`.`status_pesanan` NOT IN ('Dibatalkan') AND `o`.`status_pembayaran` IN ('DP','Lunas') AND `o`.`tanggal_acara` IS NOT NULL ORDER BY `o`.`tanggal_acara` ASC, `o`.`id` ASC
